crossRefs.note: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…

translations.web: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
translations.bsb: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
translations.kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
translations.asv: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
